home.title: Hi, I'm Matheus
home.subtitle: Software Engineer & Low-Level Developer
home.description: Systems Analysis and Development student at Fatec Jundiaí, focused on software engineering and low-level programming. I enjoy building things from scratch, from web apps to compilers and graphics programs.
home.about_description: I combine systems programming fundamentals with practical full-stack delivery, and I actively study engineering books such as Clean Code, Clean Architecture, The Pragmatic Programmer, and others to sharpen how I design and maintain software.

projects.title: My Projects
projects.subtitle: A collection of systems, engines, and web apps I've built.

anki.title: Anki My
anki.description: A modern spaced-repetition flashcard application built with React and Rust. Features offline-first support and efficient learning algorithms.

firstgameengine.title: First Game Engine
firstgameengine.description: A custom 2D/3D game engine built from scratch using OpenGL, GLFW, and GLEW. Features shader loaders, asset rendering, and collision detection.

gameoflife.title: Conway's Game of Life
gameoflife.description: An interactive, high-performance simulation of Conway's Game of Life in C++ using Raylib for rendering. Supports custom seed shapes and speed controls.

petadopt.title: Pet Adoption System
petadopt.description: A full-stack pet adoption management web app featuring user profiles, pet cataloging, adoption workflow matching, and secure forms.

compiler_rust.title: Rust Compiler
compiler_rust.description: A compiler developed in Rust that parses a simple custom language and generates x86-64 assembly as the intermediate representation.

compiler_cpp.title: C++ Compiler
compiler_cpp.description: A compiler written in C++ featuring scanner, parser, AST generation, and basic code execution for a lightweight programming language.
